claire_radar.whyItMatters: Current PCQA benchmarks focus on scalar prediction, leaving gaps in diagnostic and interpretable quality assessment. PointQ-Bench addresses this by evaluating models on multi-faceted quality understanding tasks, which is crucial for practical inspection scenarios where identifying defects and assessing usability is necessary.
